title: Autoclave
program_note: Autoclave was originally conceived as a composition using exclusively hand-held per­cussion instruments.  Nevertheless, the Bar Chime, Bell Tree, Guiro, Triangles, and Vibraslap should be mounted, the Woodblocks may be mounted, and the Energy Chime should rest on the table in its cradle.  The word “Autoclave” literally refers to a self-locking (“auto-” = “self,” “clave” = “lock”) device for sterilizing medical instruments through high temperature and pressure devel­oped in a sealed container.  But it also is meant as a pun on the musical word “clave,” which itself has two meanings:  the instrument called “claves” (a pair of solid hardwood cylinders held in the hands), and the rhythmic figure most characteristically played on claves in Latin America.  Auto­clave, then, is meant as a high-pressure self-propelling composition involving hand-held instru­ments and particular rhythmic figures.
